meta.note: Ranked intelligence alerts. NO ALERTS ARE FABRICATED: each is either sourced from the client brief (marked BRIEF-SOURCED), from documented public-record events (verify), or is a explicitly-labelled MODEL/SCOUT flag. Levels: RED immediate strategic/safety, ORANGE important, YELLOW emerging, BLUE knowledge update.

alerts.title: National road fatality burden persists (11,485 deaths; 45% pedestrians)
alerts.body: RTMC 2025 state-of-road-safety dataset records 11,485 fatalities and 9,734 fatal crashes; pedestrians ~45%; Gauteng ~20%.
alerts.soWhat: This is the core evidence base for positioning autonomy as a safety intervention; concentrate pedestrian-exposure intelligence where it is highest.

alerts.title: DoT direction toward AV legislative framework — no enactment yet
alerts.body: Department of Transport has identified development of a legislative framework for autonomous vehicle technology as a priority.
alerts.soWhat: Cardinal regulatory watch item. Direction exists; law does not (as at tracker date). Track every consultation/gazette step.

alerts.title: Global trucking autonomy expanding toward emerging markets
alerts.body: Kodiak moving into Australia (off-road/long-haul); Aurora/Torc/Waymo Via scaling US hub-to-hub; trucking autonomy is the nearest-fit global wave for N3/N1.
alerts.soWhat: Prepare SA corridor data, safety case methodology and ODD work now so SA can host the wave when regulation opens.

alerts.title: Mining autonomy is SA's most deployable autonomy domain today
alerts.body: Private mine roads = geofenced ODD with no public-road legal change needed; global tech via Caterpillar/Komatsu/Epiroc.
alerts.soWhat: Prioritise mining-domain engagement (analytics, remote-ops services, readiness scoring) as near-term revenue + proof.

alerts.title: No gazetted automated-driving instrument found (tracker audit)
alerts.body: Audit of the current tracker's legal layer finds no operative comprehensive automated-driving regulation.
alerts.soWhat: Confirms private-road-only deployment envelope today; ZeroValue of planning public-road pilots now is contingency, not imminent.

alerts.title: Data moat is open: no known public SA driving dataset
alerts.body: No publicly available South African road-scene dataset is yet identified.
alerts.soWhat: The dataset programme is the highest-leverage build: it gates perception research, validation and downstream products.

alerts.title: EV-autonomy convergence strengthens (NEV white paper + localisation)
alerts.body: EV white paper and APDP localisation direction support new-energy vehicles; autonomy and electrification converge for fleets.
alerts.soWhat: Design corridors/pilots electric-first to capture the convergence and charging economics.

alerts.title: Telematics/fleet-software national depth is an un-advertised asset
alerts.body: SA-founded telematics platforms (Mix, Ctrack) operate at global scale.
alerts.soWhat: Fleet intelligence + safety analytics is a commercially real, POPIA-manageable entry lane available now.
